Welcome to the CVS Equine channel.

CVS Equine provides industry leading equine veterinary services to patients and clients in over 50 sites across the UK, Netherlands, Northern Ireland and Republic of Ireland.
 
We offer exceptional clinical credibility with over 20 Equine Veterinary Diploma holders giving an unrivalled spectrum of specialisms to treat all equines, from pleasure horses to elite athletes.

To find a CVS Equine veterinary practice or hospital near you, go to the CVS Equine website (link below).
